recognition.text:
Proof
by induction
①
① Theaem :
let P(n) be a property defined for
a natural number n.
If I can show that:
P(n_0) is true ( basic step)
P(n) → P(n+1) is true for n ≥ n_0
( inductive then)
then I can say that P(n) is
true for all m ≥ m_0 .
② Exemple :
P(n):   1 + 2 + ... + n = m(n+1)/2
